newsitem.title: USA: Delta news conference to name top executives.
newsitem.headline: Delta news conference to name top executives.

text.p: Delta Air Lines called a news conference Friday morning to name top officers, including a successor for former Chairman Ronald Allen, who left in July after 34 years when the board declined to renew his contract.

Delta announced the news conference, scheduled at 1100 EDT/1500 GMT at Atlanta's Hartsfield Airport, following a published report saying the nation's third largest carrier would name Leo Mullin, the vice chairman of Unicom Corp, to Allen's post.
